scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 38 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-alba-iulia-palatul-guvernatorului.story: From Alba Iulia it runs 331 km to Alba Iulia; allow about 5 h 42 of riding. It goes by way of Capâlna, Comărnicel I, Voineasa - Crac-Găuri and Monastery of Horezu. The highest point is about 1,600 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
